questions.question: Who are you?
questions.answer: I'm Chamathka Nethmini, a final-year Information Technology undergraduate at the University of Moratuwa and a full-stack developer passionate about building AI-powered applications, intelligent systems, and user-focused digital experiences. I enjoy combining software engineering, artificial intelligence, and creative problem solving to build products that solve real-world problems.

questions.question: Tell me about yourself.
questions.answer: I'm a final-year BIT student at the University of Moratuwa with a strong interest in software engineering, artificial intelligence, and data-driven applications. Throughout my journey, I have built full-stack applications, AI tools, data engineering pipelines, and IoT-integrated systems. Some of my notable projects include ChamaGPT, an AI-powered portfolio assistant, an Azure Data Factory ETL pipeline, an AI document assistant using RAG, and my final year smart park-and-ride reservation system. I enjoy learning new technologies and transforming ideas into practical solutions.

questions.question: Introduce yourself as if you are in an interview.
questions.answer: I'm Chamathka Nethmini, currently completing my Bachelor of Information Technology at the University of Moratuwa. My main interests are full-stack development, artificial intelligence, and data engineering. I have hands-on experience building applications using technologies such as Next.js, React, Spring Boot, Python, SQL, and cloud platforms. I enjoy creating products that combine technical functionality with good user experiences. Beyond development, I actively participate in technology communities through mentoring and volunteering because I believe continuous learning and collaboration are important parts of becoming a better engineer.

questions.question: Why did you choose software engineering?
questions.answer: I chose software engineering because it allows me to transform ideas into solutions that can impact people's daily lives. I enjoy the process of understanding problems, designing systems, writing code, and continuously improving products based on user needs.

questions.question: Why are you interested in AI?
questions.answer: I'm interested in AI because it changes the way software can interact with users and solve problems. Building projects like ChamaGPT and my AI Document Assistant helped me understand how AI can enhance traditional applications by making them more intelligent, personalized, and efficient.

questions.question: What are your career goals?
questions.answer: My goal is to become a skilled software engineer who can build intelligent, scalable, and user-focused products. I want to continue growing in areas such as AI engineering, full-stack development, and data-driven systems while contributing to meaningful technology projects.

questions.question: What type of company do you want to join?
questions.answer: I am interested in joining a company that values innovation, learning, collaboration, and engineering excellence. I want to work with teams where I can contribute to real products while continuously improving my technical and professional skills.

questions.question: Why should we hire you?
questions.answer: I bring a combination of software engineering skills, AI knowledge, and a strong willingness to learn. I have demonstrated my ability to build complete solutions independently, from frontend interfaces and backend APIs to AI integrations and data pipelines. I enjoy solving problems, adapting quickly, and taking ownership of projects.

questions.question: What makes you different from other developers?
questions.answer: I believe my combination of creativity and technical curiosity makes me different. I don't only focus on writing code; I think about the user experience, the problem being solved, and how technology can create value. My projects often combine multiple areas such as AI, cloud, data, and IoT.

questions.question: Tell me something that is not on your resume.
questions.answer: Outside of development, I enjoy photography and learning new languages such as Japanese, Chinese, and French. I believe these activities improve my creativity, communication skills, and ability to understand different perspectives.

questions.question: Where do you study?
questions.answer: I am currently pursuing my Bachelor of Information Technology degree at the University of Moratuwa.

questions.question: Why did you choose University of Moratuwa?
questions.answer: The University of Moratuwa has a strong reputation in technology education and provides opportunities to develop both technical knowledge and practical problem-solving skills.

questions.question: Tell me about your education journey.
questions.answer: I completed my Ordinary Level studies at Kottawa Dharmapala Maha Vidyalaya and Advanced Level studies at Vidyakara National Girls' School. After that, I started my Bachelor of Information Technology degree at the University of Moratuwa, where I developed my interest in software engineering, AI, and emerging technologies.

questions.question: What have you learned outside university?
questions.answer: Outside university coursework, I have expanded my skills through personal projects, online learning, certifications, open-source development, and experimenting with modern technologies such as AI frameworks, cloud platforms, and full-stack development tools.

questions.question: How do you continue learning?
questions.answer: I learn by building projects, exploring documentation, taking online courses, participating in technology communities, and experimenting with new technologies. I believe practical implementation is one of the best ways to understand concepts deeply.

Career_Profile.professional_summary: A final-year Information Technology undergraduate specializing in full-stack development, AI applications, and data-driven systems. Experienced in building modern web applications, RAG-based AI tools, ETL pipelines, and IoT-integrated solutions through academic and personal projects.

Frontend_Development.summary: I have hands-on experience building modern, responsive web applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS. I focus on creating reusable components, clean user interfaces, good user experiences, and scalable frontend structures.

questions.question: Explain your React experience.
questions.answer: I have used React to build interactive frontend applications including StudyMate and other web projects. My experience includes creating reusable components, managing application state, integrating APIs, handling user interactions, and building responsive interfaces.

questions.question: Explain your Next.js experience.
questions.answer: I use Next.js for building modern full-stack web applications because it provides excellent performance, routing, server-side rendering capabilities, and a structured development approach. questions.question: Why do you use Tailwind CSS?

questions.question: What backend frameworks have you used?

questions.question: How do you design APIs?
questions.answer: I design APIs by first understanding the application requirements, defining resources and endpoints, implementing proper request and response structures, validating inputs, handling errors, and ensuring secure communication between frontend and backend.

questions.question: What databases have you worked with?
questions.answer: I have worked with MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and SQLite across different projects. I have used relational databases for structured application data and MongoDB for flexible document-based storage.

questions.question: Explain your SQL experience.
questions.answer: I have experience designing database structures, creating tables, writing queries, managing relationships, performing CRUD operations, and connecting databases with backend applications.

AI_Machine_Learning.summary: I have explored AI application development by building RAG-based systems, AI assistants, document intelligence tools, and integrating AI models into applications.

questions.question: Explain your AI experience.
questions.answer: My AI experience focuses on building practical AI applications rather than only studying theory. I have developed projects involving Retrieval-Augmented Generation, document question answering, AI assistants, and integrating language models into software products.

questions.question: What is your experience with RAG?

questions.question: Why are you interested in AI engineering?
questions.answer: AI engineering allows me to combine software development with intelligence. I enjoy creating systems that can understand information, assist users, automate tasks, and provide personalized experiences.

Data_Engineering.summary: I have experience building ETL workflows, processing datasets, transforming data, and creating analytics solutions.

questions.question: Explain your data engineering experience.
questions.answer: I have worked on ETL pipelines where I extracted raw data, cleaned and transformed it, stored it in databases, and created dashboards for analysis. My Superstore ETL Pipeline project demonstrates my understanding of cloud-based data workflows.

questions.question: What is ETL?
questions.answer: ETL stands for Extract, Transform, Load. It is the process of collecting data from sources, cleaning and transforming it into a useful format, and loading it into a destination system for analysis or application use.

Cloud_DevOps.summary: I have experience deploying applications, working with cloud services, and exploring modern development workflows.

questions.question: Explain your Docker experience.

ChamaGPT.overview: ChamaGPT is an AI-powered portfolio assistant designed to transform a traditional static portfolio into an interactive conversational experience. Instead of visitors reading through multiple pages, they can ask questions and explore my skills, projects, education, and experience through natural conversation.
ChamaGPT.problem: Traditional portfolios only display information. They require recruiters to manually search through sections to understand a developer's background. ChamaGPT solves this by providing a conversational interface where users can directly ask about projects, technologies, and experience.

architecture.answer: The application uses a frontend conversational interface connected with structured portfolio knowledge data. User queries are processed and relevant information is retrieved to generate contextual responses.

interview_questions.question: Why did you build ChamaGPT?
interview_questions.answer: I built ChamaGPT because I wanted to make my portfolio more interactive and memorable. Instead of presenting information through static pages, I wanted recruiters and visitors to have a conversation and discover my experience naturally.

interview_questions.question: What makes ChamaGPT different from a normal portfolio?
interview_questions.answer: A traditional portfolio only displays information, while ChamaGPT creates an interactive experience. Visitors can ask questions about my projects, skills, and background as if they are talking with an AI representation of my professional profile.

interview_questions.question: What did you learn from building ChamaGPT?
interview_questions.answer: I learned that building AI applications requires more than connecting a model. Good knowledge organization, user experience design, prompt structure, and understanding user intent are equally important.

Smart_Park_and_Ride.overview: Smart Park and Ride Reservation System is a sensor-based smart parking solution designed for integrated transport hubs in Sri Lanka. The system helps commuters reserve parking spaces before arrival while providing real-time parking availability through IoT sensors.
Smart_Park_and_Ride.problem: Traffic congestion is increased when commuters spend time searching for parking spaces. Existing parking facilities often lack real-time availability and automated management systems. This project aims to encourage park-and-ride adoption by making parking more convenient and efficient.

architecture.answer: The system follows a full-stack architecture. The Next.js frontend communicates with Spring Boot REST APIs. The backend manages users, reservations, and parking data while IoT components provide real-time physical parking information.

technical_questions.question: Explain your final year project.
technical_questions.answer: My final year project is a sensor-based smart park-and-ride reservation system designed for integrated transport hubs in Sri Lanka. Users can reserve parking slots online, receive a QR code, and use it for access verification. The system also integrates IoT sensors to monitor parking availability in real time.

technical_questions.question: How does the QR gate system work?
technical_questions.answer: When a user reserves a parking slot, the system generates a unique QR code. At the entrance, an attendant scans the QR code. The backend verifies the reservation, and if it is valid, a servo motor automatically opens the gate.

technical_questions.question: How does IoT integration work?
technical_questions.answer: Each parking slot uses sensors to detect occupancy. The sensor data can be sent to the system backend, allowing users to view real-time parking availability.

technical_questions.question: Is the system fully automated?
technical_questions.answer: Currently, the system is semi-automated. Reservation management, QR verification, and gate control are automated, while some physical processes still require human involvement. Future improvements aim toward complete automation.

technical_questions.question: What was the biggest challenge?
technical_questions.answer: The biggest challenge was integrating software with hardware components. Building the system required considering communication between the application layer and physical devices while keeping the architecture maintainable.

Superstore_ETL_Pipeline.overview: An Azure Data Factory ETL pipeline that processes Superstore retail sales data from CSV files into Azure SQL and connects the cleaned data with Power BI analytics dashboards.
Superstore_ETL_Pipeline.problem: Organizations often have raw data stored in different formats that cannot directly support analytics. This project demonstrates how automated pipelines can prepare data for decision-making.

interview_questions.question: Explain your ETL pipeline.
interview_questions.answer: I built an Azure Data Factory pipeline that extracts retail sales data from CSV files stored in Azure Blob Storage, loads it into Azure SQL, and prepares it for Power BI visualization.

interview_questions.question: Why did you choose Azure Data Factory?
interview_questions.answer: Azure Data Factory provides a visual and scalable approach for building data workflows. It allowed me to understand cloud-based ETL orchestration and data movement between services.

interview_questions.question: What did you learn from this project?
interview_questions.answer: I gained practical understanding of cloud data engineering concepts including data ingestion, transformation workflows, cloud storage, databases, and analytics.

AI_Document_Assistant.overview: An AI-powered document assistant that allows users to upload PDF documents and ask questions using natural language. The system uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation to retrieve relevant information from documents before generating answers.
AI_Document_Assistant.problem: Reading and finding information inside large documents can be time-consuming. This project explores how AI can help users interact with documents more efficiently.

architecture.answer: The system follows a RAG architecture. Documents are processed and split into smaller chunks, converted into embeddings, stored in ChromaDB, and retrieved when users ask questions. The retrieved context is then used to generate accurate responses.

interview_questions.question: Why did you use RAG instead of directly asking an LLM?
interview_questions.answer: A general LLM does not know private document information. RAG allows the system to retrieve relevant information from a specific knowledge source and provide more accurate, context-aware answers.

interview_questions.question: What did you learn from this project?
interview_questions.answer: I learned how modern AI applications are built using retrieval systems, embeddings, vector databases, and language models instead of only relying on model training.

Global_Superstore_Dashboard.overview: A Power BI analytics dashboard created using the Global Superstore dataset to analyze sales performance, profitability, customer behavior, and regional trends.
Global_Superstore_Dashboard.problem: Businesses collect large amounts of data but need meaningful insights to support decisions. This project demonstrates transforming raw data into actionable analytics.

interview_questions.question: How did you prepare the data?
interview_questions.answer: I cleaned and transformed the dataset using Python and pandas by handling missing values, fixing data types, removing duplicates, and preparing calculated fields before importing it into Power BI.

interview_questions.question: What did you learn from this project?
interview_questions.answer: I learned how data cleaning, visualization, and analytics can transform raw datasets into useful business insights.

Hotel_Liyera.overview: Hotel Liyera is a hotel booking platform originally developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and currently being modernized using Next.js, Flask, MongoDB, and Tailwind CSS.
Hotel_Liyera.problem: The project explores how digital platforms can simplify hotel information management and booking experiences.

StudyMate.overview: StudyMate is a student productivity application designed to help users manage tasks, track study sessions, and improve learning consistency.

interview_questions.question: Why did you build StudyMate?
interview_questions.answer: I built StudyMate to solve a personal productivity problem faced by students. The goal was to combine task management with study tracking in one simple application.

AI_Interview_Question_Generator.overview: An AI-powered application that generates customized technical and behavioral interview questions based on job role, experience level, and domain.

interview_questions.question: Why did you create this application?
interview_questions.answer: I created this project to explore how generative AI can improve career preparation by creating personalized interview practice experiences.
